headline: “Tojikiston Amudaryodan O‘zbekistonning haqqini olgani yo‘q”. Suv xo‘jaligi vaziri — Rog‘un GESi haqida
summary: Tajikistan's construction of the Rogun hydropower dam will take at least four to five more years, with reservoir filling stretching to about 2035. Water minister Shavkat Khamrayev said Tajikistan is not taking the Amu Darya water allocated to Uzbekistan.
why: Rogun is a major hydropower project, and water-sharing disputes in Central Asia affect energy supply, agriculture and regional cooperation.
